description: Contextual replacements whose nested fragments srcMove must not report as moves.

cases.rationale: A renumbered numeric literal is data, not a moved code unit.
Swapped numeric values do not constitute moved statements.
An identifier reused across replacements is not independently movable.
A type keyword produced by reordered declarations is not a move.
A shared signed specifier is not a moved declaration.
A repeated diagnostic string is not independently movable code.
A boolean value reused by two edits is not a moved statement.

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { boolean value() { return false; } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { boolean value() { return true; } }

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { boolean value() { return true; } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { boolean value() { return false; } }

cases.rationale: The null literal has no useful move identity by itself.

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { Object value() { return current; } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { Object value() { return null; } }

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { Object value() { return null; } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { Object value() { return replacement; } }

cases.rationale: A property or variable name is below statement granularity.

SourceCase.cs: class SourceCase { int Value() { return total; } }
DestinationCase.cs: class DestinationCase { int Value() { return count; } }

SourceCase.cs: class SourceCase { int Value() { return count; } }
DestinationCase.cs: class DestinationCase { int Value() { return result; } }

cases.rationale: A repeated string value is not a moved construct.
A two-character operator is not a movable code unit.

source.c: int source(int a, int b) { return a != b; }
destination.c: int destination(int a, int b) { return a == b; }

source.c: int source(int a, int b) { return a == b; }
destination.c: int destination(int a, int b) { return a <= b; }

cases.rationale: A member name reused during API edits is not a move.

source.cpp: int source(const Box& box) { return box.size; }
destination.cpp: int destination(const Box& box) { return box.length; }

source.cpp: int source(const Box& box) { return box.length; }
destination.cpp: int destination(const Box& box) { return box.capacity; }

cases.rationale: An array index literal is data rather than moved behavior.

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { int value(int[] a) { return a[8]; } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { int value(int[] a) { return a[10]; } }

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { int value(int[] a) { return a[10]; } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { int value(int[] a) { return a[12]; } }

cases.rationale: A built-in type name is not independently movable.
An enum member name crossing two replacements is not a move.
A template type argument is not a complete moved construct.
A method name alone is below statement granularity.

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { void value(Service s) { s.start(); } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { void value(Service s) { s.run(); } }

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { void value(Service s) { s.run(); } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { void value(Service s) { s.stop(); } }

cases.rationale: A property name alone is not a moved statement.

SourceCase.cs: class SourceCase { int Value(Box box) { return box.Size; } }
DestinationCase.cs: class DestinationCase { int Value(Box box) { return box.Count; } }

SourceCase.cs: class SourceCase { int Value(Box box) { return box.Count; } }
DestinationCase.cs: class DestinationCase { int Value(Box box) { return box.Capacity; } }

cases.rationale: A character literal is not independently movable code.
A boolean literal reused by replacements is not a move.
